summary: Fed's first hike in 3 years to ~4% drove a defensive, financials-led ASX tape: XJO +0.41% to 8732.4 but on negative breadth (94 adv/97 dec). Financials XFJ +1.42% led; gold miners were the biggest losers (WAF -7.37%, PNR -7.45%) on crowded-trade profit-taking. EIQ +14.56% on an FDA update. Regime Bearish; RBA meets 29 Sep with hike pressure rising.
